subject: Urgent: Short-window throughput uplift + phased true-up for ClearNorth launch
messages:
From: Alex Novak <alex@clearnorth.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Sethi <priya.s@clearnorth.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Launch weekend capacity ask

Hey Mateo —

We have a hard launch scheduled for this Saturday at 10:00am ET (marketing confirmed). Traffic projection shows a 6x spike for a 6-hour window. We need a short-term throughput uplift to avoid errors and tail latency > 2s.

Can Redwood provide a short-window increase to our quota and a higher burst rate for that period? We prefer a simple true-up on Monday invoiced against actual consumption. Also keen to understand any short-term rate caps and whether you can offer a capped overrun rate vs the standard overage schedule.

We can sign a short SOW or amend the current order form. Happy to hop on a quick call.

—Alex
Product Lead, ClearNorth

Attachments: traffic-estimate-weekend.csv (attachment stub)
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Alex Novak <alex@clearnorth.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Launch weekend capacity ask

Alex —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the launch. We can support a short-window uplift. Proposed immediate path:
- Temporary quota uplift (6x) for Sat 06/05 08:00–14:00 ET.
- Enable burst rate upgrade (higher token/sec) for the same window.
- Monday true-up invoiced against measured overrun.

Two items we need to resolve quickly:
1) Pricing: we can offer a capped overrun rate for the uplift window (1.5x of standard per-token rate) if ClearNorth agrees to a short SOW and a modest one-month commit increase post-launch. Without a commit, the standard overage matrix applies (higher).
2) Authorization: signoff from procurement or PO is required for the uplift. DocuSign or signed SOW is fine.

I'll draft an uplift SOW and a one-page pricing matrix. Looping in Karthik for pricing nuance and Laura for procurement guidance. If you want an alternate: we can do a refundable credit instead of a commit if you prefer less lock-in (credit amount based on forecast).

—Mateo
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 11:07:00 -04:00
Subject: FW: Launch weekend capacity ask

Quick internal —

Alex from ClearNorth needs 6x capacity for ~6 hours this Saturday. They prefer Monday true-up and ask for a capped overrun price during the uplift window. Two options I proposed to them: short SOW + 1-month commit bump for capped rate at 1.5x standard, or refundable credit (no commit) sized to their forecast. Need pricing worksheet and one-page SOW ASAP (I'll send to Alex).

Can you confirm the acceptable capped multiplier for a no-commit option and the preferred wording for the SOW (procurement requires PO vs DocuSign)?

—Mateo
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 13:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: FW: Launch weekend capacity ask

Mateo —

Proposed pricing approach:
- If customer signs 1-month commit bump (non-cancellable for that month): overrun cap = 1.5x standard token rate for uplift window.
- If customer prefers no-commit, offer a refundable credit option: we reserve capacity and hold a refundable credit equal to 40% of forecasted uplift spend; overrun billed at 1.9x standard rate but refundable credit reduces net exposure.
- Minimum uplift fee: $3,000 for the window (covers provisioning).

Operational notes: need a short SOW (we can use SOW template SW-Uplift-2025) and procurement language: "PO accepted or DocuSign signature required prior to uplift start." Laura, confirm if PO-only is required for ClearNorth's profile or DocuSign is acceptable.

I'll attach a terse pricing matrix and SOW draft.

—Karthik
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: uplift-pricing-matrix.xlsx (attachment stub)
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Alex Novak <alex@clearnorth.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2026 09:34:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Launch weekend capacity ask — proposal and next steps

Alex —

Thanks for the patience. Attached are: short SOW (20260602-ClearNorth-short-window-SOW.pdf) and a simple pricing matrix (uplift-pricing-matrix.xlsx). Summary of the offer:
- Option A (preferred): 1-month temporary commit bump. Overrun cap for uplift window = 1.5x standard token rate. Minimum uplift fee $3,000. PO or DocuSign accepted.
- Option B (no commit): refundable credit equal to 40% of forecast uplift spend up front, overrun billed at 1.9x standard rate; unused credit refunded within 10 business days after reconciliation.

Requested next steps:
1) Confirm Option A or B by 5:00pm ET on Thursday 06/03 so we can provision.
2) If Option A, reply with PO or sign the SOW (DocuSign link below). If Option B, confirm and we'll send an invoice for the refundable credit.

DocuSign (SOW): https://docusign.com/s/clearnorth-uplift-2026
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/1187

Happy to take a 15-min call to walk through terms.

—Mateo
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20260602-ClearNorth-short-window-SOW.pdf, uplift-pricing-matrix.xlsx
From: Alex Novak <alex@clearnorth.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Sethi <priya.s@clearnorth.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2026 16:38:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Launch weekend capacity ask — proposal and next steps

Mateo —

We appreciate the quick turnaround. ClearNorth will take Option A (1-month temporary commit bump) and sign the SOW via DocuSign now. Priya (cc'd) will handle procurement and send PO if needed. Please provision the uplift for Sat 06/05 08:00–14:00 ET and confirm monitoring alert thresholds and SLOs for the window.

Thanks for the clear options — this works.

—Alex
Product Lead, ClearNorth
